sentences: An Empress and the Warriors is a 2008 Chinese historical drama film directed by Ching Siu -tung and starring Donnie Yen, Kelly Chen, Leon Lai and Kou Zhenhai.
Die Screaming, Marianne( also" Die, Beautiful Marianne") is a 1971 British low- budget film by minor cult director Pete Walker.
Although Walker ’s films were mostly in the horror or sexploitation genres, this is a straight thriller, with mild horror undertones.
Deathstalker and the Warriors from Hell, also known as Deathstalker III: The Warriors from Hell, is a 1988 sword and sorcery fantasy film.
It is the third film in the "Deathstalker" tetralogy.
In English, the film is sometimes referred to as Momotaro's Divine Sea Warriors or Momotaro: God Warriors of the Sea.
